MODULE 1B · TRAINER-SUPERVISED PRACTICE

Transfer Pendings & Sign Off

Complete Module 1B with a trainer after finishing Module 1A. In this activity, you will learn how to handle pending work before signing off and then complete the Spectrum sign-off procedure correctly.

Why is this completed with a trainer?
Pending work affects live operations and may not be present every time you practice. A trainer must coordinate the activity when appropriate pending work is available, guide the transfer, and verify that the work is transferred correctly before you sign off.

Trainer Required

Do not complete the pending-work transfer independently. Tell your trainer that you are ready for Module 1B — Transfer Pendings & Sign Off. Follow the trainer's instructions throughout the live activity.

Part 1 — Transfer Pending Work

Before signing off, any pending work assigned to your operator session must be handled correctly. Your trainer will guide you through the live transfer process.

Identify pending work.
The trainer will show you how to recognize that pending work exists and explain what is currently pending.
Begin the sign-off process.
Start the normal Spectrum sign-off process. If pending work is present, Spectrum will require it to be handled before the session can be finished.
Select the dispatcher station.
When the transfer option is presented, use the drop-down list to select the dispatcher station identified by your trainer.
Select Transfer.
Transfer the pending work to the dispatcher rather than leaving it behind on your operator session.
Verify the transfer.
Stop and confirm with your trainer that the pending work was transferred successfully before continuing to sign off.

Important

Do not continue past the transfer step until your trainer confirms that the pending work was transferred correctly.

Part 2 — Sign Off

After your trainer confirms that the pending work has been handled, complete the Spectrum sign-off procedure.

Start sign-off.
Press SN OFF on the Spectrum keyboard or use the On-Off Agent Shortcut.
Complete validation.
When Spectrum presents the sign-off validation, follow the prompt shown on the screen.
Confirm sign-off.
Press Y when Spectrum asks you to confirm that you want to sign off.
Verify Idle.
Confirm that Spectrum returns to the Idle state. This indicates that your operator session has ended.
Remember:
When pending work exists, transferring it is part of the sign-off process. The pending work should be handled first, then the sign-off should be completed and verified by returning to Idle.
